title: Verification record
description: Produced by the coordinator between receiving expert JSON and writing the report. Every item the report presents must have a confirmed entry; everything removed or demoted is listed with its reason.

books.description: One entry per selected book per expert. Identity is confirmed once, in workflow step 3, against official author or publisher material before the list is forwarded; model recall is not identity proof. Practices are checked in step 7.

method.description: What official author or publisher material the coordinator checked to confirm title, author, and edition.

practices_checked.description: One check per reported practice: that it belongs to the named chapter and sections and was concretely applied.

chapter.description: Verified chapter number and title from the selected edition.

sections.description: Verified sections used for this practice.

method.description: How the coordinator confirmed that the reported chapter or section supports the practice and checked that its application follows from the architecture evidence.

source_checks.description: One independent check per external URL that reaches the report: every Tech lead source note used, and every standard cited in a standards_conformance entry.

expert_role.description: Role id of the expert that cited the source.

source_id.description: The Tech lead source_notes[].id; omitted for a standard cited by another lens.

method.description: How the coordinator checked the URL, the source date or version when exposed, relevance, and concrete application; for a standard, that the cited clause exists and supports the verdict.

entries.description: One entry per finding, option, upheld practice, or corrective action that reaches the report.

item.description: The claim, option name, practice, or action verified.

lenses.description: The expert role id(s) whose analyses support this item; duplicates merge here.

method.description: What was read, run, or compared to check it, distinguishing reading from running. A parity, performance, or coverage claim is confirmed only by citing a command actually run and its relevant output; established by reading alone, it reaches the report as an assumption.

final_severity.description: Review tasks: the severity after re-grading against the contract definitions; state it even when unchanged.

proof_assessments.description: One production-proof check per major recommendation, option, or evolution step. This records evidence and a delegated proof spec; it does not require the panel to execute missing proof.

confidence.description: direction: architecture evidence or sources support the shape. provider: target-provider docs or examples support it. operational: a real command, test, deploy, or drill proved it in the target shape.

evidence.description: The code, source, document, or command output behind this confidence level.

missing_proof.description: What has not been proven yet; use 'none' only for operational proof.

next_smallest_proof.description: The smallest concrete delegated proof spec that would raise confidence: owner task, acceptance evidence, observations to capture, and pass/fail conditions. Do not imply the panel has run it or must implement it.

removed.description: Expert output that does not reach the report.

reason.description: Refuted by evidence, duplicate merged elsewhere, praise without evidence, grade the risk text failed to justify, or out of scope.
